title: Messi Hamstring Scare — Exits Inter Miami Match Early; Argentina Monitors Fitness 14 Days From Group J Opener
detail: Lionel Messi left Inter Miami's 6-4 MLS win over the Philadelphia Union in the 73rd minute on May 24, clutching the back of his left hamstring. Inter Miami's medical staff subsequently confirmed the issue as a 'muscular overload associated with fatigue' — not a structural tear — offering initial relief for Argentina's World Cup preparations. At 38, Messi's availability remains the most-watched fitness story of the entire tournament. Argentina's first Group J match is June 16 vs Algeria at Children's Mercy Park, Kansas City, giving him time to recover. Pre-tournament friendlies are scheduled for June 6 (vs Honduras) and June 9 (vs Iceland). Messi had been confirmed in Argentina's 55-man provisional squad on May 11; the final 26-man squad is expected May 30, with FIFA publishing all 48 squads simultaneously on June 2. Adidas' 'El Último Tango' boots — widely read as his farewell to international football — add to the anticipation.

media.caption: Messi exits Inter Miami vs Philadelphia Union in 73rd minute with hamstring issue — Argentina medical team monitors 14 days before World Cup

title: FIFA Club Player Release Deadline — Clubs Worldwide Required to Release World Cup Squads by May 25
detail: May 24, 2026 marked the final club matchday for players named in confirmed World Cup squads, with FIFA's mandatory release protocol requiring clubs to release selected players to their national teams by May 25. Exceptions were granted for clubs participating in continental finals through May 30 — most notably Achraf Hakimi (PSG), who must be available for the UEFA Champions League Final vs Arsenal on May 31 before joining Morocco. Players from all 48 qualified nations began the transition to national team training camps during this window. The release deadline is a critical logistical milestone with the tournament opening June 11 at Estadio Azteca. Several clubs pushed back on early release dates due to end-of-season fixtures, with Real Madrid and Manchester City among those completing league campaigns to the final day.

media.caption: FIFA club player release deadline — national teams begin receiving players for World Cup preparations on May 25
